The repeating identical arm creates a long cross-pairing cascade (position 10-108, etc. — the arms pair with each other across the multiloop). The arm sequence is too GC-rich and self-complementary across copies. I need each arm to be different so they don't cross-pair. The key insight: the four arms are identical in structure, so if I use identical sequences, G's in arm1 pair with C's in arm4. 

Solution: design the whole target as ONE unit but seed ViennaRNA inverse_fold with many restarts in parallel. My earlier Python inverse_fold got dist 17. def worker(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    ss=''.join(random.choice('ACGU') for _ in range(n))

            if res[0]<best[0]:
                best=res
                print('dist',res[0],'t',round(time.time()-start,1),flush=True)

import RNA, random, time
target='.....((((.(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).)))).....'
n=len(target)
# precompute pairs
pairs=[]; stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')': j=stack.pop(); pairs.append((j,i))
partner={}
for i,j in pairs: partner[i]=j; partner[j]=i
paired=set(partner.keys())

start_seq='AAAAAGGGGACCCGGGGGAGCCGCAUAAGCAGGGACCCGGGGACACCGCAGAAGCAGGGAGGCACGGGAACGGCGGAAGCGGCCAGGGACGGAAACGGCAUCAGCACCCACCCCAAAAA'

def dist(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq); mfe,_=fc.mfe()
    return RNA.bp_distance(mfe,target)

cur=list(start_seq); d=dist(start_seq)
best=cur[:]; bd=d
start=time.time()
rng=random.Random(42)
while time.time()-start<100:
    if bd==0: break
    # mutate: pick a paired position, change pair to another WC, keep partner consistent
    r=rng.random()
    if r<0.6 and pairs:
        (i,j)=rng.choice(pairs)
        choice=rng.choice(['GC','CG','AU','UA'])
        oi,oj=cur[i],cur[j]
        cur[i]=choice[0]; cur[j]=choice[1]
        nd=dist(''.join(cur))
        if nd<=d:
            d=nd
            if nd<bd: bd=nd; best=cur[:]
        else:
            cur[i]=oi; cur[j]=oj
    else:
        i=rng.randrange(n)
        if i in paired: continue
        old=cur[i]
        cur[i]=rng.choice(['A','C','G','U'])
        nd=dist(''.join(cur))
        if nd<=d:
            d=nd
            if nd<bd: bd=nd; best=cur[:]
        else:
            cur[i]=old
    if int(time.time()-start)%15==0 and rng.random()<0.1:
        print('best',bd,'t',round(time.time()-start,1),flush=True)
print('FINAL dist',bd)
print(''.join(best))
EOF
